about_the_game:
Cubetory is a factory-building game with a deep focus on automation. You'll place mining drills, conveyor belts, launchers, stampers, power stations, and tons of other machines as you build your factory. Unlock new technologies and fully leverage them to work through the 4 levels of progression available in the demo. With no enemies or time limits, you’ll have all the time you need to perfect your design.

Paint-based manufacturing with the P.I.T.

Your goal is to produce specific types of cubes by mining, painting, and assembling them, then delivering those cubes to the PIT.  You'll never have to remove old supply lines — only upgrade them — as your factory will need to produce every type of Supply Cube to progress.

Supply lines and Rate of Production

Each new tier of technology is unlocked by reaching a target rate of production, perfect for people who love tweaking their factory to run just right. New tiers introduce advanced technologies, more room to build, and new types of cubes you'll need to deliver to the PIT.

short_description: Create the ultimate cube processing factory on an island that grows with your base! Progression is tied to your rate of production, so you'll face lots of scaling challenges as you work your way through increasingly difficult production chains. No enemies, no time limit, pure automation goodness.
